notes.title: Lone Fungus: Melody of Spores is on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44571331/2cd0d728ca50647af6ee558d065c6ed1c7e82061.png[/img]

Lone Fungus: Melody of Spores is currently live on Kickstarter!
Check it out here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/620777061/lone-fungus-melody-of-spores]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/620777061/lone-fungus-melody-of-spores[/url]

This is a great chance to grab the game early or even get a spot in beta testing, which will be held on Steam, exclusively for backers! I appreciate any support the project gets even if it's just sharing the project with your friends! Thank you everyone!
